versions.changelog:
etix-mcp 0.3.0

- No user-facing changes or file updates detected in this release.
- Documentation, features, and setup instructions remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No other user-facing changes in this version.

- Adds ability to search Etix events, venues, and performers, and retrieve detailed event/venue info via natural-language prompts.
- Requires etix-mcp and fetchproxy extension with an open Etix browser tab for real-session data access.
- Provides tools for event/venue lookup, keyword search, location resolution, and bridge health check.
- Reads public event discovery data via your own browser session; no Etix account or public API required.
- Clear documentation for setup, use, and terms acknowledgment included.
